title: Setups page: "Pick for WCS" takes no viewport pick - clicks still select the whole model

labels.name: P1
labels.description: Unsafe or wrong output: gouge, collision, wrong G-code, crash, data loss; blocks a cut

labels.name: source:agent
labels.description: Opened by an AI agent (not a human reporter)

labels.name: effort:high
labels.description: Several crates, new behaviour with tests; safety floor (issue-worker-high)

body:
Reported by the maintainer (2026-11-13, in chat, on a v0.19.0 build): "this section under Setup<n> is to set WCS - but it cannot really select any edges, points or gizmo axises.. so not sure what its supposed todo?" Priority P1 is the maintainer's ("Make P1 issue for it").

What happens: on the Setups page, the row "Set WCS from features - each pick sets a role" is armed with "Pick for WCS". The status line says to pick faces, edges, corners or walls, but a click in the viewport selects the whole model as usual. Nothing is highlighted on hover, no "Picked: ..." line appears, and Apply never becomes available.

What should happen (issue 701, the row's own hover text): while the row collects, a click on a face, an edge, a corner or a curved wall is taken as the pick for the role in the box (Origin, X, Y, Z), and the hover highlights what the click would take.

Cause, from the code:
- `crates/ui/src/interact.rs` (about lines 104-108) sends a viewport click to `feature_click::click` only when `state.geo_pick` is Face, Edge or Vertex. In `GeoPick::Model`, the default (`state.rs`), the click goes to `pick_model`. The hover has the same gate (about line 185).
- `crates/ui/src/wcs_pick.rs` `arm` leaves `geo_pick` as it is, on purpose ("the toolbar's pick mode is the user's own"). Every other pick draft switches it when armed: `plane_pick` (Face), `points_pick` (Vertex), `axis_pick` (`mode_of(by)`), `locate_pick` (Face), the boundary pick (Model to Edge).
- The only control that changes the mode is "Click selects:" on an operation's Geometry page (`egui_app/geo_page.rs`), which is not shown on the Setups page. So with no operation open the mode is Model and the role draft can never receive a pick. `feature_click::ask` and `click` already handle the armed row correctly (faces, edges and points together); they are just never reached.
- Why the tests did not catch it: `egui_app/wcs_pick_tests.rs` sets `geo_pick = GeoPick::Vertex` by hand or calls `wcs_pick::take` directly. No test arms the row from the default mode and clicks through `interact`.

Not a defect: the gizmo axes are not a pick target of this row by design. If picking a gizmo axis as a role is wanted, that is a separate enhancement.

Suggested fix: while `wcs_pick::collecting(state)`, route viewport clicks and hover to `feature_click` whatever `geo_pick` is (as `wcs_ui.pick_circle` already does for the hover), or have `arm` leave Model mode and restore the previous mode on disarm, pause and Apply. Check the same gate for any other draft that relies on the mode it sets being left alone.

Done means: from a fresh project (pick mode Model, no operation open), arming "Pick for WCS" and clicking a face, an edge and a corner in the viewport records each as "Picked: ..." with its role, the hover highlights the feature under the cursor, and Apply places the WCS; pinned by a ui test that arms the row from the default mode and drives the click through `interact` (not `wcs_pick::take`); disarming gives the previous click behaviour back.
